items: Once you pass roughly five locations, manual review monitoring stops being efficient, and guest experience software that pulls all feedback into one place becomes worth adopting.

Look for centralized feedback, AI insights on recurring issues, review replies, automated post-visit surveys, multi-location dashboards, and integrations with your POS, reservations and loyalty systems.
Track satisfaction by location, shift and channel, response rate and time, recurring complaint themes and rating trends, so you see which stores and issues need attention first.
Momos unifies reviews, messages, survey responses and delivery app feedback from every location in one Unified Inbox, so you can measure guest experience and act on it.
